# Get player effects with positions
player_effects_with_positions <- foul_binomial_model_vs_1 %>%
  spread_draws(r_primary_defender[primary_defender,]) %>%
  group_by(primary_defender) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_effect = mean(r_primary_defender),
    lower_95 = quantile(r_primary_defender, 0.025),
    upper_95 = quantile(r_primary_defender, 0.975)
  ) %>%
  left_join(defender_positions, by = "primary_defender")

# Get top and bottom 10 players by position
top_bottom_by_position <- player_effects_with_positions %>%
  group_by(defender_position) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_effect)) %>%
  slice(c(1:10, (n()-9):n())) %>%
  ungroup()

# Get distance effects for these players
player_distance_effects <- foul_binomial_model_vs_1 %>%
  spread_draws(r_primary_defender[primary_defender,], r_defense_distance_category[category,]) %>%
  # Calculate the combined effect for each player and distance category
  mutate(combined_effect = r_primary_defender + r_defense_distance_category) %>%
  # Filter to only include our selected players
  filter(primary_defender %in% top_bottom_by_position$primary_defender) %>%
  # Get summary statistics
  group_by(primary_defender, category) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_effect = mean(combined_effect),
    lower_95 = quantile(combined_effect, 0.025),
    upper_95 = quantile(combined_effect, 0.975)
  ) %>%
  # Add position information
  left_join(defender_positions, by = "primary_defender") %>%
  # Add overall effect for ordering
  left_join(
    top_bottom_by_position %>% select(primary_defender, mean_effect),
    by = "primary_defender",
    suffix = c("_distance", "_overall")
  )
